installed: Installed into {path}; takes effect in new {shell} sessions
updated: Updated {path}; takes effect in new {shell} sessions
foreign: {path} wasn't written by shellhook, so it was left alone; move it away to install
old_hook: The old version's {path} is also there: both would take over Enter and send each message twice; delete it if you no longer use the old version
unknown_shell: Can't tell which shell this is: pass --shell fish, --shell bash or --shell zsh
status_stale: {shell}: installed ({path}), but the program it calls, {program}, is gone; install again
no_program: Can't find the program to call from the script: {program}
renewed: Started a new session: the last message was {ago} ago
slash_pending: /{name} isn't available in the shell yet
